about.heading: About
paragraphs: PBLAND is a seed-stage startup, since 2026, based in Korea and Japan. Friends from various industries come together to quickly build small businesses, take on outsourced development, and rapidly add features for clients.
We turn an idea into something that actually runs, in short cycles, then keep attaching the automation and integrations that day-to-day operations need.
We would rather finish what is needed now and move to the next step than grow the scope for its own sake.

items.title: Fast MVP and small-business builds
items.body: We put up the first working form of a small business quickly, cut to a range you can use and check.

items.title: Outsourced development
items.body: We take on development that already has a direction, and build the screens, integrations, and operational features inside an agreed scope.

items.title: Feature additions and operations automation
items.body: We add features to a service that is already running, or automate the repetitive work of operating it.

portfolio.heading: Work
portfolio.lede: Development support we have taken on.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.body: We talk through what you want to build, and how much of it is needed now.

steps.title: Confirm scope
steps.body: We split what this round will include from what can wait, and agree the scope.

steps.title: Rapid build
steps.body: We implement the agreed scope in a short cycle and hand over something you can actually use.

steps.title: Operate and extend
steps.body: As it runs, we attach the operational work and the next features that show up.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: For a small business, outsourced development, or a feature to add, write to cs_pbland9@pbland9.com.
